title: pyrus meuselii
intro: Pyrus meuselii, commonly known as Chinese pear or Mei pear, is a species of flowering plant in the family Rosaceae. It is a deciduous tree or shrub with edible fruit, native to China. The health benefits of Pyrus meuselii include antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which may help protect against chronic diseases such as cardiovascular disease and cancer. The bioactive constituents of Pyrus meuselii include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and polysaccharides, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including anti-oxidative, anti-inflammatory, and immune-modulating effects.
